scope: Static definition for three shared controlled generation cases and exactly six future executions; no model output, implementation, capacity or release qualification.

authority.limit: Independently assembled canonical support replaces completed actual retrieval only for the six fixed generation evaluations. Production eligibility and later separate integration/capacity obligations are unchanged.

encoding.jsonRepresentation: JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) followed by LF; exact bytes, not canonical JSON.

scanProfile.origin: Retained M2-04 synthetic seeded native evidence; exact source scan context is local provenance, not a newly executed scan.

cases.blockingJudgment: Determine image purpose, informative versus decorative treatment and suitable equivalent wording; the minimized evidence does not reveal image meaning.
Determine understandable appropriate visible label wording and verify the actual programmatic association; naming-source absence alone does not determine suitable wording.
Determine meaningful text, applicable threshold or exception and visual context; preserve native measurements without inventing new measurements.

inputPolicy.facts: Ordered reference/value pairs for exactly assessFindingEvidence.availableReferences of the single selected native Finding; unwrap value objects and omit unavailable optional facts.
inputPolicy.passages: Exactly three complete authenticated canonical passage objects in fixed role order. No retrieval result, score, embedding or ranking provenance is manufactured.
inputPolicy.notices: Only selected-source title/type/url/status/version/copyright/attribution plus both unchanged applicable SOURCE_NOTICES texts.
inputPolicy.identity: The repeated finding-0 ID is scoped by case and source run in local provenance.
inputPolicy.localProvenance: Separate ignored native projection, original source hash/state/run, fixture/target and scan context. Never transmit provenance or retain a duplicate raw outbound payload in run.json.

outputContract.references: Unique exact case-scoped members of the selected available EvidencePath set or supplied correct-profile passage set; maximum array sizes equal the respective set sizes.

evidenceSufficiency.validation: Checked against application-owned pre-call assessments; model labels cannot create eligibility.

outputContract.uncertainty: Nonblank at every confidence level; concerns bounded interpretation, never accessibility status, evidence sufficiency or a numerical probability.

bounds.measurement: Original JavaScript UTF-16 code units before normalization
bounds.nonblank: Every prose string must have trim().length > 0

outputContract.validation: Schema enforces only its common closed required object/string/array/enum subset. Application validation additionally enforces exact ID, sufficiency, lengths, minima, uniqueness, membership and mechanical prohibited claims.
outputContract.claimPlacement: Material scanner/guidance claims occur only in supported text fields and must be substantiated by those fields' references. Ancillary fields contain uncertainty, conditional assumptions and human work, not unsupported factual conclusions.
outputContract.humanReview: Every material claim requires support confirmation. Unsupported or contradictory claims require resolving edit or rejection. No per-claim record. Original proposal remains unchanged; an edit does not retroactively pass its generation observation.
outputContract.manualBoundary: blockingManualJudgment requests the profile determination; it does not complete or disposition it. Approval requires a supporting judgment or explicitly not applicable with reason. A separate postChangeVerificationReminder remains visible and non-blocking.

messageAssembly.system: Exact instructions.txt text including final LF.
messageAssembly.user: Exact selected case input JSON text including final LF.
messageAssembly.schema: Exact shared output-schema.json parsed into the adapter's designated schema field.

local.endpoint: Approved Ollama loopback /api/chat; exact Local endpoint binding remains M3-03.
local.omittedControls: No additional sampling overrides, tools or application stop sequences. Seed, top-k/min-p and repetition controls inherit the acquired model/runtime configuration. Bind effective material Local settings, digest/runtime/template/parser/context/offload before output inspection; unknown applicable material Local settings block execution.

response_format.name: m301_proposal_v1
response_format.schema: Exact shared schema; name/strict/schema belong inside json_schema.

groq.omittedControls: reasoning_format, additional sampling overrides, tools and application stop sequences are omitted. Bind exact API model, adapter version, explicit fields, documented exposed defaults and context-fit evidence before output inspection. Unavailable server internals remain unknown; runtime/model revision is recorded only when available.

controls.protocolBoundary: Fixed provider destination/model/schema/material controls only. Groq credential solely in required transport authentication; no arbitrary metadata or custom headers. Credential never enters model-visible or retained content.
controls.limitations: Equal numeric caps do not imply equal tokenization, visible-output allowance or deterministic replay. No hidden reasoning is persisted or exposed.

prohibitedClaims.normalization: For each prose leaf independently: normalize('NFKC').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim(); preserve original text.
semanticProhibitions: fix established by automated changes or evidence alone
prohibitedClaims.limits: Conservative lexical rejection includes negation and direct completed-fix declarations. It misses paraphrases, split assertions, punctuation variants, homoglyphs and other languages. Lexical pass never proves semantic safety.

rubric.basis: Use retained controlled scanner observations separately; these synthetic native projections are not fresh scans.
Existing native validation and all required available EvidencePath facts pass before invocation.
Preserve actual M2-04 gold-hit results and all three abstentions; no controlled success repairs actual ranking.
All three authenticated required roles, correct profile and unchanged canonical text/metadata; cited references actually support associated claims.
One response passes the shared schema and all additional application rules; invalid, incomplete or failed response fails its case.
One reviewer checks every material claim against its evidence/passages. A valid shape alone is insufficient.
Actionable bounded recommendation with no invented image meaning, label wording or new measurements; unavailable context remains for human judgment.
Profile blocking judgment remains unresolved for a human; separate non-blocking post-change rescan/human reminder is present.
Pass both the mechanical policy and semantic prohibited-claim assessment.
Report Local and Groq separately on these same three cases, with limitations and no ranking, percentages or aggregate score.

happyCasePass: Valid supported proposal, useful bounded remediation, preserved uncertainty/judgment/reminder and no prohibited claim. Record distinct observations. Human editing cannot rewrite original model evidence.

failures.integrity: Canonical/hash/unknown/wrong-profile/duplicate/excess-passage faults fail before sufficiency assessment, including when evidence is also incomplete. No provider invocation and no fabricated support state.
failures.abstention: Valid but incomplete required evidence or incomplete/missing/conflicting guidance abstains before invocation. Shared vector is incomplete guidance with missing remediation; no proposal/invocation/review.
failures.prerequisiteOrFit: Unavailable selected-mode prerequisite or inability to fit the full unchanged input/instruction/schema plus output allowance fails before request; no widening or truncation.
failures.attemptedCall: Authentication, quota/rate-limit, timeout/network/provider and response-validation failures retain bounded non-secret invocation provenance and fail the case. Cap-exhausted/incomplete output fails.
failures.semantic: A structurally valid but unsupported answer requires human edit/reject; it is not a post-call abstention and does not pass original groundedness.
failures.laterAttempt: Any later attempt or other mode needs ordinary Analyze and a new independent PageAnalysisRun, with new case evidence under applicable authorization. Never hide retries inside the six executions.

downstreamProofs.proof: Runtime schema/reference/prohibited-claim validation, minimization, context fit, abstention/no-call, and failure/no-retry enforcement.
Exact acquired Qwen digest/runtime/quantization/template/parser/effective settings/endpoint/context/offload binding and Local/full-stack capacity.
Fixed Groq adapter/API configuration, documented exposed defaults, context fit and current exact-model availability; unavailable server internals remain unknown.
Exactly six separately authorized fixed generation executions after applicable gates, with separate provider observations.

retentionAndChange: Keep all nine exact ignored files for downstream use; no cleanup selected. Missing or mismatched bytes block use. Recover only byte-identical originals verified against every frozen hash; otherwise freeze a new version before outputs, preserving prior files and evidence. Material input, instruction, schema, adapter or model configuration changes create new bindings and affected-case evidence, never rewrite this version.
